title: Second Aorist Verbs
objectives: recognize and write the second aorist paradigm,
write out the second aorist stems of the verbs learned in previous lessons,
gain more practice in translating and working with Greek,
master 10 more high frequency vocabulary words,

content.text: In English we have two ways of forming the past tense.

items: Add the "-ed" suffix to the word: I [[u]]laugh[[/u]] at Elliott's jokes (present). I [[u]]laughed[[/u]] at Elliott's jokes (past).
Change the root of the verb: Zach [[u]]runs[[/u]] down the court (present). Zach [[u]]ran[[/u]] down the court (past).

content.text: Like English, Greek forms the past in two ways.
The first aorist is formed from the present stem with an augment and a suffixed σα.
The second aorist is built from a different aorist root by adding second active personal endings which are identical to the imperfect forms.

The aorist is the most frequently used tense in the New Testament. Both the first and second aorists are usually translated as a simple past (i.e. He came...). The two types of aorists function in exactly the same way in sentences.
The second aorist is presented first because of its similarity to the imperfect.
The aorist is used for undefined action in the past (e.g. He loosed). The imperfect was used for continuous action in the past (e.g. He was loosing).

While the endings parallel those of the imperfect, note carefully that the aorist root is different. There is no way to predict how the second aorist root is formed; thus it must be learned by memory. First aorists use the present stem.
The second aorist is built from the second aorist verb stem. It is preceded by an (ε) augment and followed by secondary endings like the imperfect.

topics.title: Augments

content.text: The augment is added in four ways:

items.text:
before vowels the augment contracts with the vowel according to the following rules:
α + ε = η      ε + ε = η      ο + ε = ω
ει + ε = ῃ     αι + ε = ῃ     οι + ε = ῳ
αυ + ε = ηυ    ευ + ε = ηυ

below.label: Contraction Examples
below._disclosure: C1: chart payload behind an in-text "Examples" link -> accordion. The clips are chapter 12's l_ex1-10, duplicated into the CHAPT_14 pack by the ISO (Stage 6 self-containment).

items.text:
Compound verbs with prepositions ending in a consonant: insert the augment between the prepositional prefix and the verb stem.
ἐκβάλλω becomes ἐξέβαλον

Compound verbs with prepositions ending in a vowel: the final vowel of the preposition is dropped and the ε augment inserted in its place.
ἀποκτείνω becomes ἀπέκτεινα

content.text: Most would see ἔβλεψα as the aorist of βλέπω and have εἶδον come from ὁράω (I see). In any case, it is a second aorist and is translated "I saw."

drill.title: Second Aorist Indicative Translation Drill

items.greek: Μαριάμ, εὗρες γὰρ χάριν παρὰ τῷ θεῷ
options: Mary by grace found God
for Mary found favor with God
Mary, for you have found favor with God
items.answer: Mary, for you have found favor with God

options: and he threw [it] to the earth
and you threw [it] to the earth
and they threw [it] to the earth
items.answer: and he threw [it] to the earth

items.greek: Ὅτι εἶπόν σοι ὅτι εἶδόν σε ὑποκάτω τῆς συκῆς,
options: Because I said to you that I saw you under the fig tree, you believe?
Because they said to you that we saw you under the fig tree, you believe?
Because he said to you that he saw you under the fig tree, you believe?
items.answer: Because I said to you that I saw you under the fig tree, you believe?

items.greek: ἐγενόμην ἐν πνεύματι ἐν τῇ κυριακῇ ἡμέρᾳ
options: he was in the Spirit on the Lord's day
we were in the Spirit on the Lord's day
I was in the Spirit on the Lord's day
items.answer: I was in the Spirit on the Lord's day

items.greek: ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ ἦν, καὶ ὁ κόσμος δι' αὐτοῦ ἐγένετο
options: we were in the world, and the world was made by him
he was in the world, and the world was made by him
they were in the world, and the world was made by them
items.answer: he was in the world, and the world was made by him

items.greek: εἶπαν οὖν οἱ μαθηταὶ αὐτῷ, Κύριε ...
options: Therefore they said to his disciples, "Lord...
Therefore he said to the disciples, "The Lord...
Therefore the disciples said to him, "Lord...
items.answer: Therefore the disciples said to him, "Lord...

items.greek: Εὗρον Δαυὶδ τὸν τοῦ Ἰεσσαί, ἄνδρα κατὰ τὴν
options: We found David son of Jesse a man after my heart
I found David son of Jesse a man after my heart
He found David son of Jesse a man after my heart
items.answer: I found David son of Jesse a man after my heart

items.greek: εἶδεν δύο ἀδελφούς, Σίμωνα τὸν λεγόμενον Πέτρον
options: They saw two brothers, Simon called Peter, and Andrew his brother
I saw two brothers, Simon called Peter, and Andrew his brother
He saw two brothers, Simon called Peter, and Andrew his brother
items.answer: He saw two brothers, Simon called Peter, and Andrew his brother

items.greek: πάτερ δίκαιε, καὶ ὁ κόσμος σε οὐκ ἔγνω, ἐγὼ δέ
options: Righteous father, although the world does not know you, I know you
Righteous father, although the world does not know me, you know me
Righteous father, although the world does not know them, they know me
items.answer: Righteous father, although the world does not know you, I know you

items.greek: καὶ εἶπεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς, Εἰς κρίμα ἐγὼ εἰς τὸν κόσμον
options: And Jesus said, "For judgment I came into this world"
And Jesus said, "For judgment you came into this world"
And Jesus said, "For judgment he came into this world"
items.answer: And Jesus said, "For judgment I came into this world"

items.greek: ὅτε οὖν εἶδεν ὁ ὄχλος ὅτι Ἰησοῦς οὐκ ἔστιν ἐκεῖ
options: When, therefore, the crowd saw Jesus was not there
When, therefore, they saw Jesus was not in the crowd
When, therefore, we saw Jesus was not in the crowd
items.answer: When, therefore, the crowd saw Jesus was not there

items.greek: οὐχ εὗρον τὸ σῶμα τοῦ κυρίου Ἰησοῦ
options: he did not find the body of the Lord Jesus
we did not find the body of the Lord Jesus
they did not find the body of the Lord Jesus
items.answer: they did not find the body of the Lord Jesus

items.greek: καὶ ἐξῆλθον οἱ μαθηταὶ καὶ ἦλθον εἰς τὴν πόλιν
options: and the disciples went out and came into the city
and the disciples went out and he came into the city
and the disciples went out and we came into the city
items.answer: and the disciples went out and came into the city

items.greek: Καὶ ἐγένετο ὡς ἀπῆλθον ἀπ' αὐτῶν εἰς τὸν
options: And it happened as the angels came to them from heaven
And it happened as the angels went from them into heaven
And it happened as the angels were going from them into heaven
items.answer: And it happened as the angels went from them into heaven

items.greek: ἀλλὰ διὰ τοῦτο ἦλθον εἰς τὴν ὥραν ταύτην
options: but on account of this he came to this hour
but on account of this I came to this hour
but on account of this we have come to this hour
items.answer: but on account of this I came to this hour

items.greek: σχίσμα οὖν ἐγένετο ἐν τῷ ὄχλῳ δι' αὐτόν
options: Thus there was a division in the crowd because of Him
Thus there was a division in the crowds because of Him
Thus there was a division in the crowd because of them
items.answer: Thus there was a division in the crowd because of Him

items.greek: ὅτι εἶπον ὅτι Οὐκ εἰμὶ ἐγὼ ὁ Χριστός
options: that he said that he was not the Christ
that he said "I am not the Christ"
that I said "I am not the Christ"
items.answer: that I said "I am not the Christ"

items.greek: Καὶ ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ὥρᾳ ἐγένετο σεισμὸς μέγας
options: and in that hour there were great earthquakes
and in that hour there was a great earthquake
and in that hour they were in a great earthquake
items.answer: and in that hour there was a great earthquake

items.greek: Οὐκ ἐγώ σε εἶδον ἐν τῷ κήπῳ μετ' αὐτοῦ;
options: I saw you in the garden with him didn't I?
We saw you in the garden with him didn't we?
She saw you in the garden with him didn't she?
items.answer: I saw you in the garden with him didn't I?

items.greek: καὶ ἦλθον πρὸς τὸν Ἰωάννην καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ,
options: and they came to John and said to him, "Rabbi ..."
and he came to John and said to him, "Rabbi ..."
and they came to John and he said to him, "Rabbi ..."
items.answer: and they came to John and said to him, "Rabbi ..."

items.greek: καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ, Τί οὖν Βαπτίζεις εἰ σὺ οὐκ
options: we said to him, "Why then are you baptizing if you are not the Christ"
he said to him, "Why then are you baptizing if you are not the Christ"
they said to him, "Why then are you baptizing if you are not the Christ"
items.answer: they said to him, "Why then are you baptizing if you are not the Christ"

items.greek: εἶδεν αὐτὸν ἄλλη καὶ λέγει τοῖς ἐκεῖ, Οὗτος ἦν
options: another saw him and said to the ones there "This one was with Jesus"
others saw him and said to the ones there "This one was with Jesus"
we saw him and said to the ones there "This one was with Jesus"
items.answer: another saw him and said to the ones there "This one was with Jesus"

items.greek: καὶ εἶπαν αὐτῷ, Ὁ πατὴρ ἡμῶν Ἀβραάμ ἐστιν
options: and he said to him, "Abraham is our father"
and they said to him, "Abraham is our father"
and we said to him, "Abraham is our father"
items.answer: and they said to him, "Abraham is our father"

options: we saw his glory
he saw his glory
they saw his glory

items.greek: καὶ ἐγένετο μετὰ ἡμέρας τρεῖς εὗρον αὐτὸν
options: And it happened after three days she found him in the temple
And it happened after three days they found him in the temple
And it happened after three days we found him in the temple
items.answer: And it happened after three days they found him in the temple

items.greek: Μετὰ ταῦτα ἦλθεν ὁ Ἰησοῦς καὶ οἱ μαθηταὶ
options: After these things Jesus came to the disciples in the land of Judea
After these things Jesus' disciples came to the land of Judea
After these things Jesus and his disciples came to the land of Judea
items.answer: After these things Jesus and his disciples came to the land of Judea

items.greek: καὶ ἀπῆλθεν εἰς τὴν πόλιν καὶ λέγει τοῖς
options: and she went into the city and said to the men
and they went into the city and said to the men
and we went into the city and said to the men
items.answer: and she went into the city and said to the men

items.greek: εἶπον οὖν πρὸς αὐτὸν οἱ ἀδελφοὶ αὐτοῦ
options: Therefore he said to his brothers
Therefore his brothers said to him
Therefore they said to his brothers
items.answer: Therefore his brothers said to him
